summary: User requested smaller default card density and visible search matches
expected: The board should fit more tickets vertically and make it clear why a search result matched.
actual: User could see only two tickets per column in the initial view; sample lanes contained at most two cards and search only filtered without highlights.
correction: Reduced card typography/padding/gaps without truncating descriptions, expanded clearly fictional fixtures to 12 (4 Ready/3 In progress/3 Blocked), and added shared literal case-insensitive matching plus safe React mark rendering in all searchable fields. Eliminated cross-field phrase matches that had no visible text to highlight.
evidence: Three new tests failed before implementation; now 14 tests and build pass. Desktop 1440x900 fits four Ready and three In progress cards. Browser BOARD query: 4 cards/5 highlights; WAITING: 1 card/1 highlight; clear:12 cards/0 highlights. Mobile 390x844 no page overflow. Independent code review found no actionable issues.
